items.html: After everything that was made to create the four worlds ABYA had been sorted, Adam haRishon was created to complete and to sort through his actions and Mitzvot [commandments]. Through the Mitzvot and the prayers to scrutinize the scrutinies, these kings were joined in the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Bad in their dross. Then he, too, died, and his entire offspring after him, to sort his parts that were mixed with good and evil like the kings. This is the meaning of the incarnation, as it is explained in its place. For this reason, there are angels that die and are renewed each day, as it is written, “creator of His servants,” etc. This is enough for the understanding, for the pen fails to detail everything.
